title: Earthworm Jim 2

rows: Snott swing / sticky jump (hold A to parachute with Snott)

widgets.text: Most 'bosses' are mini-games: bounce Peter's puppies to safety (Puppy Love), guide the balloon in Inflated Head, answer the quiz in Jim's mind.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Anything But Tangerines, Lorenzo's Soil, Puppy Love 1-3, Villi People, The Flyin' King, Udderly Abducted, Inflated Head, ISO 9000, See Jim Run, Level Ate, Jim's dream finale.

rows: Smart bomb that clears the screen

widgets.text: Atoms and ammo crates are the main pickups; extra lives hide off the main path.
Password-free: progress is per sitting; the level order is fixed.

notes: found by RAM search 2026-10-25 and checked against the HUD over a 9000-frame run of Anything But Tangerines: health 100 -> 80 -> 40 -> 20 -> 0, lives 3 -> 2, plasma 1000 -> 993 -> 1243 (pickup), current-weapon ammo = the HUD counter (x3 with a special gun).
